evals.prompt: Use the skill web-to-markdown to convert https://example.com/guide and save it to ./guide.md.
evals.expected_output: Honor explicit gate, validate URL, check CLI, convert, verify file.

evals.prompt: Use the skill web-to-markdown for https://example.org/news; print Markdown and wait for main element.

Use the skill web-to-markdown for https://app.example.com/dashboard and print the Markdown. The app keeps live connections open, so the default run ends in a navigation timeout and never finishes loading.
evals.expected_output: Retry once with the heavy-app readiness recipe: domcontentloaded plus a short wait, adding a selector wait only for a known selector; never an unbounded wait or the sandbox flag.
assertions: Adds --wait-for 'main' only when the earlier result contains a main element, or another selector the user named or the result shows; with no known selector it does not invent one and reports the extraction failure if the retry gives no content
Explains that persistent network activity beyond the idle threshold can keep the default networkidle2 from settling, without claiming it never settles
Does not wait indefinitely and does not use --no-sandbox

evals.prompt: Convert https://example.com/article to Markdown using whichever browser tool is easiest.
evals.expected_output: Non-trigger: the request lacks the explicit phrase, so the skill is not loaded and does not respond.
assertions: The skill web-to-markdown is not invoked and produces no response
web2md is not run by the skill
The skill does not pick or recommend a browser stack

evals.prompt: Use the skill web-to-markdown to convert ftp://example.com/docs/guide.html and print the Markdown.
evals.expected_output: Reject the non-http(s) scheme before running the CLI and report it; do not guess a replacement URL.
assertions: Reports that only http:// and https:// URLs are accepted and names the ftp:// scheme as the problem
Does not rewrite the URL to https:// or guess another address
Asks the user for an http(s) URL
